def test_security_hashable():
    def func(): pass
    s1 = Security(dependency=func, scopes=["read", "write"])
    s2 = Security(dependency=func, scopes=["read", "write"])
    s3 = Security(dependency=func, scopes=["read"])
    
    assert hash(s1) == hash(s2)
    assert s1 == s2
    assert hash(s1) != hash(s3)
    assert s1 != s3
    print("Security is hashable and handles scopes correctly")
